mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relationship involving gains, losses and transformations of N among pools in the soil."

Succession is called primary if the development of the ecosystem starts from zero on the suddenly released rocks, lava-stream or sand dune.

Lignin is the main component of wood in trees.

respiration is called net primary production (NPP), or the accumulation of standing plant biomass (and that of other autotrophs).

Soils are the part of the earth's surface, which form a narrow interface between the atmosphere and the lithosphere.
